quests.title: Resort Zone: the Pal Park's Fixed Catch mode (wild Pokémon by weekday)

wild.place: Pal Park, Fixed Catch mode: Wednesday
notes: The wild table changes with the day of the week (by the DS clock). You get in through the Catching Show's Fixed Catch mode at the Pal Park reception ($10,000; bring your own Poké Balls). Sunday's table is the same as Cerulean Cave's, probably by mistake in the hack, so it also has Surf and fishing slots: the park has a pond and a stretch of sea.

acquisitions.conditions: After the Cianwood Gym story opens the Resort Zone, enter Pal Park’s Fixed Catch mode for $10,000 with room for six more Pokémon in the PC. This standing Pokémon appears on Wednesday or Friday. Bring your own Poké Balls.

Rescue Prof. Birch from Poochyena on Route 12, then accept Torchic. Missable: collect it before the Rainbow Badge ceremony hides Birch. Wake the blocking Snorlax to reach him in time. Leave a free party slot.
